title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 4.91 (versions follow prime numbers; 491 after 487): more talk to eat. Four more plays in the public domain on her shelf (over 8,400 speeches in all, only what is said); in her panel, her talk with her author stays on the left and her study on the right; a thread ends when who speaks to her changes. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v4.91: más comida de diálogos. Prototipo de investigación.
